normalClientCapture.scope: Matching target IPv4/UDP and RustClient socket endpoints observed at capture start/end; no PID filter in pktmon
normalClientCapture.privacy: No identity, position, angle, item, raw button value or authentication payload is exported
limitations: Partial mid-session capture; no initial ProtoDelta baseline, full gameplay reconstruction or causal public-count proof.
Network cadence is observed capture timing and may contain buffering and packet loss.
Explicit field presence/change only; missing delta fields are not treated as zero.

conclusions: The seven project sessions were admitted but all seven had Health=0 in live server playerlist; their worker metadata also retained a dead own state.
Normal official client sent continuous real Tick frames and explicit button changes. The independent worker only implements a bounded initial wake and connection maintenance, not ongoing gameplay.
This baseline does not test an official-client run of a project test account or identify which accounts Facepunch has counted. No public count repair is established.
After the frozen baseline, all seven existing project game sessions and the original official normal account left; do not attribute that cohort change to a single account.
limitations: Existing normal account had already been connected about 4.5 hours; no pre-join baseline for that account.
Health=0 versus positive is a correlation, not the Facepunch eligibility formula. Other live players exceed the public count as well.
Observed average Tick cadence describes this capture only and is not an implementation target or universal Rust client cadence.

The live watcher uses a nonexistent overview steamId property for officialProjectIdentityHasPrimaryGameSession; that boolean is not evidence. Resolve project account id through /v1/accounts and compare overview id instead.
Ongoing main sampler has a fixed original-normal identity; use the private identity timeline and exact rosters to attribute a later test-account run.
No per-account public adoption receipt; public refreshes and unrelated roster/eligibility changes can confound differences.
